rows.name: Hall Effect/Rapid Trigger
rows.note: Keychron V6 Ultra HE Kickstarter enters week 3 near funding plateau; Gamakay Q2 and XTRFY MK Crystal TMR keep magnetic switches the dominant switch story.

rows.name: Cherry MX2A
rows.note: Still shipping as default across mainstream boards, but Cherry's own XTRFY TMR push continues to pull spec-sheet attention away from MX2A.

rows.name: Gateron Oil King
rows.note: Lineup and stock unchanged at Gateron, KBDfans, Divinikey since the early-2026 four-switch expansion; no new SKUs or restocks this week.

rows.name: Durock T1
rows.note: Fresh Geekhack tactile-thread interest as reviewers compare T1 against Gateron Lanes; thock's own deep dive is drawing incremental search traffic this week.

rows.name: GMK CYL OG Extensions
rows.note: Geekhack GB closes Wed Aug 12; final-days push unlocks higher MOQ tiers across Prototypist, NovelKeys, and Sandkeys Middle East kittings.

rows.name: GMK CYL TA Neo
rows.note: Production still tracking toward Nov 2026 ship per Oblotzky/zFrontier; community attention fully diverted to the OG Extensions close this week.

rows.name: Divinikey DCS Dolch
rows.note: Kitting/MOQ chatter on Divinikey's GB page keeps thinning out; Oct 2026 ship estimate unchanged, five weeks post-close.

rows.name: GMK Beachy
rows.note: GB opens Aug 18 across Keebz N Cables (Oceania), Divinikey (US), Prototypist (UK), KBDfans (China), Unikeys (Canada); interest-check activity rising ahead of launch.

rows.name: Split/Ergo layout
rows.note: Split boards (Glove80, ZSA Voyager, Kinesis Advantage360 Pro) remain 2026's dominant keyboard search trend per continuing ergo-roundup coverage.

rows.name: Alice layout
rows.note: Decline deepens as buyers keep favoring full split boards; no new Alice-format releases or GBs surfaced this week.

rows.name: 75% Layout
rows.note: Mode's Encore 2026 refresh and KBD75 v3 keep 75% boards in the spotlight; steady incremental interest, no new triggers this week.

rows.name: Work Louder x OpenAI Codex Micro
rows.note: Resale still holding near $700-800 on eBay; Work Louder has not announced a restock date, interest cooling slightly from peak.

rows.name: Mode Designs
rows.note: Mode's own Summer 2026 Update details Sonnet/Encore fulfillment progress, Prologue development status, and an Envoy final-stock announcement.

rows.name: Prototypist
rows.note: Paper 65 GB kit still tracking toward Q4 2026; Prototypist's role kitting the closing GMK CYL OG Extensions GB adds modest traffic this week.

rows.name: CannonKeys
rows.note: Blaine V2: SE closed Aug 9 after its July 10-Aug 9 run and is now listed sold-out on CannonKeys, targeting a Q1 2027 ship; interest cools into fulfillment mode.

rows.name: Keychron
rows.note: V6 Ultra HE Kickstarter holds dominant keyboard-news momentum entering week 3; continued hybrid Nova Socket coverage across tech press.

rows.name: Cherry (MX + XTRFY)
rows.note: XTRFY MK Crystal TMR keeps closing the gap in spec-comparison threads even as core MX2A production stays unchanged.

rows.name: Wuque Studio
rows.note: Wuque's July 26 product-update blog post and an active Ikki68 Aurora listing resurface in searches; still no new GB or Mammoth V2/Promise V2 confirmation.
